info.title: Lucille · Escape v1 API
info.description: Journal, Mood Scan + Mood Stats, Soundscapes AI, Self-Care Score + Plans, GDPR. Send 'Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>' and 'X-Timezone: <IANA tz>' on every call.

get.summary: Liveness for the v1 routers
Feature flags + static config the app reads once at launch (cache 1h)

post.summary: Cloud Scheduler (hourly): deliver due 'letters to future self' as push notifications

get.summary: Profile state: streak, coins, energy level, prefs

patch.summary: Update time zone, name and preferences

get.summary: Unified streak, coins and Energy Scan unlocks (1,000 coins per energy center)
The 7 energy centers (Grounding -> Purpose) and unlock thresholds
Home in one call: Mood Orb, Self-Care Score, streak, coins, today's plan, a suggestion
Lucille Suggestions for any screen. Every link is allowlisted server-side
Mood vocabulary with Mood Field coordinates (static, cache 24h)

post.summary: Preview a reading from scan inputs without saving (free, no LLM)
Save a Mood Scan / check-in. Returns the orb + suggestions

get.summary: List check-ins, newest first (cursor = createdAt of last item)
Most recent reading (seeds 'Save this moment' in the Journal)
The single conglomerate Mood Orb for week / month / year
Mood Stats page: all three periods + insights in one call
Things to do in Escape to help with a mood (allowlisted deep links)
Which Mood Orb loop + background to show right now
Journal home: one Mood Orb (period), last scan seed, weekly reflection, modes
The four modes with icon + colour keys (static)

post.summary: A prompt for the chosen mode + mood. Dataset first; guided can be personalised
Create an entry (draft or saved). Safety-checked; feeds the Mood Orb

get.summary: List entries, newest first. Filter by mode, theme, day range
One entry with its stored reflection

patch.summary: Edit an entry, save a draft, save the user's reframe or mood after

delete.summary: Delete an entry (and the check-in it created)

post.summary: Lucille reflects + optional reframe + tuned soundscape (stored; repeat calls are free)

get.summary: 14-day mood line, top themes, what feeds the Energy Scan
Lucille's weekly reflection (generated once per week, then free)
'On this day': an entry from ~1 month, 3 months or 1 year ago

post.summary: Seal a letter to future you (7 / 30 / 90 days)

get.summary: Your letters. Bodies stay sealed until their delivery date
The 9 music categories (static; cache 24h)
Browse tracks by category / mode / search. Audio = intro + 4 bodies + outro
One track with segment URLs and its Mood Orb loop
Nearest of the 36 Mood Orb loops for a mode + Mood Field (+ night twin)
Inner Weather: day phase, sun, night flag, weather (cache 15 min)

post.summary: Play for right now (Lucille Picks) or best match for a mode + Mood Field

get.summary: Lucille's Daily Drop for your cohort (date x time zone x weather)
Soundscapes home in one call: play-now pick, inner weather, daily drop, categories, recents

post.summary: Lucille Compose: queue a personal soundscape render (daily limit)

get.summary: Your compositions, newest first
Poll a composition (or listen to the Firestore doc in real time)

post.summary: Start a listening session (optionally with the 10-second mood check-in)

get.summary: Listening history

post.summary: End a session: streak, coins (1 per 5 min), before/after mood

get.summary: Saved tracks and compositions

put.summary: Save a track (trackId) or composition (cmp_...) to the Library

get.summary: Self-Care Score 0-100 with components and one next step (cached per day)
Daily score snapshots
The self-care activity library (every item is a real in-app destination)
Goals a plan can be built around

post.summary: Build a plan (catalog today; 'claude' provider when enabled)

get.summary: Active plan + today's steps

post.summary: Tick off a plan step (coins + streak)

get.summary: What each consent covers (show in onboarding + Settings)
Current consent flags + history

put.summary: Grant or withdraw consents (withdrawal is as easy as granting)

post.summary: Art. 18: pause all optional processing (AI reflection, personalisation, analytics)

get.summary: AI disclosure, crisis resources, what Escape stores (show on first chat + every few hours)
Art. 15/20: everything we hold for you as JSON (v1 data + legacy Lucille data)

delete.summary: Art. 17: erase one area (mood, journal, soundscapes, plans) or all v1 data

post.summary: Art. 17: delete the account and all data (v1 + legacy + Firebase Auth)

word.title: Word
word.description: Mood word the user tapped, e.g. 'Restless'

lat.title: Lat
lat.description: Only to pick day/night orb; not stored

flags.title: Flags
flags.description: Any of: wellbeing_data, ai_reflection, camera_scan, voice, health_data, location_weather, personalization, analytics

birthYear.title: Birthyear
birthYear.description: For minor protections; stored as an age band only

isPremium.title: Ispremium
isPremium.description: Ignored from clients; set by the RevenueCat webhook

personalize.title: Personalize
personalize.description: Guided mode only: let Lucille tailor the prompt (counts toward quota)

audioPath.title: Audiopath
audioPath.description: Firebase Storage path, if the user kept the audio
